about: Flaky tests skipped on CI: each a flake id, its owner lane and an expiry at most 24 h on, at most 3 at once. scripts/quarantine.mjs --add writes an entry and prints the test's skip; --check (and scripts/quarantine.test.mjs, on every pull request) fails once one expires.

tests.name: web_fetch set to ask on pi, claude-agent and codex at once: each run parks with its pending approval; answered more than a minute later by the owner's session, allow runs the call once and resumes with one message naming it, deny with a note resumes with the refusal; a token is 403; a second, conflicting answer is 409
tests.why: 2nd sighting of the empty-Saw class (1st: #1856 f07626bf1, job 128224311250; 2nd: tool-gate-replayed-relaunch:61, #1754 job 128568478144). faux-gate.mjs answers "Saw: <the very last message>", so an extra or reordered model request under CI load reads a bare "Saw:". Fix (tl-tools): answer from the last message with text, print the request roles on failure, and assert the model-request count separately.

tests.name: a pi run whose process died during a web_fetch it let through, relaunched with web_fetch denied, tells the model whether the call took effect is not known
